android.scope: Continuous attached native ComposeView/Paparazzi; native semantic OnClick activation and native parent ScrollState displacement. No physical OS touch, Activity/navigation/lifecycle claims.

ratings.rationale: The initial native tree contains the exact service, full location, old appointment day/time and correct contextual titles. The RTL visual range-order issue is attributed to R17 rather than pretending the underlying text changed.

The actual unmerged native tree exposes unique required tags, coherent labeled radio rows, native selected/disabled flags, Checkbox toggle state and Button enabled state. Complete enabled targets have observed touch dimensions at least48dp. The activation evidence is native semantic OnClick within the attached host; no OS touch claim.

Original initial and relevant scroll screenshots follow the supplied hierarchy, state surfaces, outline/radio treatment, system type, readable disabled content and full-width action. Theme colors and baseline type values are corroborated by native text metadata/source. Normal native font/line-break and minor vertical rhythm differences are accepted.

The original viewport sweep and checkpoint screenshots show complete wrapping without ellipsis, horizontal overflow, overlap or fixed-height clipping, including the320/1.8 large-text case. Native labels retain all strings; source uses expanding text. Offscreen viewport clipping during ordinary parent scrolling is not treated as product truncation. Raw TextLayoutResult.hasVisualOverflow is not used alone as a visible clipping failure.
Native configuration confirms requested theme/font/direction. Screenshots show corresponding palette, readable contrast and semantic leading alignment for this branch.

Native group/row identifiers preserve caller order and coherent labels contain all supplied times/details/availability/fee or unavailable reason. Original initial and scroll images show the corresponding full row content.

Native selected states match the controlled effective selection at the required checkpoints; initial free/paid choices and no automatic default are verified. Settled visual glyph state is unassessed: standard Material control glyphs retain earlier drawn state after echoes despite updated native state/content; the common animation sampling capability is pending. Do not attribute this to production local-state retention.

Actual attached-view semantics activations emit exactly the requested select event, selected-row reactivation emits none, and the unavailable row is natively disabled with a blocked activation and no callback delta.

Native summary/guidance nodes and their descendants show the requested day/time/fee for the effective selection, or the nil-selection helper with no summary. The fee-on and free-selection echoes replace guidance/summary as specified.
Conditional consent existence and native Checkbox Off/On value follow the current effective selection and caller Boolean; absence is verified where no fee applies.

Native Button enabled states match the gate. Disabled activations are blocked without a callback; enabled activations emit exactly the expected slot-specific confirm. Non-choosing initial renders have no unsolicited events.

Observed caller-controlled selection/fee echoes immediately update row native state, summary, guidance and button gate. Non-choosing native trees ignore all stale chooser input. This does not claim unexecuted external-update scenarios.
